smoke.purpose: Correctness and throughput only; not a performance claim.

pilot.purpose: Feasibility and diagnostics on development tasks.

tuning.purpose: Equal bounded tuning opportunity; validation checkpoint selection.

confirmatory.purpose: Provisional target; freeze feasible exact design and power/precision rationale before opening test results.

revision_rule: Use measured throughput and validation-only evidence to commit a revised cap before extra runs. Any new spending requires user authorization. Keep prior runs and protocol versions; do not reset consumed resources or extend final experiments to chase significance.

diagnostic.purpose: Fixed numerical, estimator, leakage and value-fitting fixtures.
